title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Test runs you can stop, tests it can find
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.42.8 finishes the third display audit's list: a test run you could not stop, test source sets the explorer never looked at, a backtick test name reported as skipped, the wrong module's icon in a multi-module project, and a string extraction that mangled raw strings.

highlights.title: Stop works from the ▶ Run lens
highlights.description: A run started from the lens carried a token nobody cancelled, so the Test Explorer's Stop button waited for Gradle to finish. The run's own token now stops it, and a backtick name ending with a parenthesis is no longer reported as skipped.

highlights.title: More test source sets discovered
highlights.description: androidUnitTest/, sharedTest/ and the KMP targets (iosTest/, jsTest/, nativeTest/, desktopTest/) join the explorer. Their classes used to get a ▶ lens that answered "test not found in index".

highlights.title: Right module, whole raw string
highlights.description: With the same drawable name in two modules the hover and gutter showed the first one indexed; the referencing module wins now. Extracting Text("""Hello""") replaces the whole literal, and \$ stays a literal dollar.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Clears only the gutter icons an editor showed and releases unused decoration types, instead of one setDecorations per type ever minted on every flush.
